messages.subject: blavaan 0.3-1 is released on CRAN
messages.body_plain:
blavaan 0.3-1 is now on CRAN. Most notably, it allows for Stan estimation, using the argument target='stan'. See here for more info:

http://faculty.missouri.edu/~merklee/blavaan/version.html

Ed

messages.subject: Re: Approximate measurement invariance
messages.body_plain:
Jorge,

blavaan does not currently make approximate MI easy; this could be improved in the future. However, the following link describes some issues related to strong priors in place of equality constraints:

https://groups.google.com/d/topic/blavaan/9hRwHucBFJs/discussion

Also, here is some info about cross-loadings (strong priors in place of zero constraints):

http://faculty.missouri.edu/~merklee/blavaan/crossload.html

Finally, if you are doing it in Stan, note that the dpriors() function also needs target="stan":

dpriors(lambda="normal(0,10)", target="stan")

In the future, I will try to remove that requirement.

Ed
